whatIs: ScrollX UI is a collection of animated, interactive React components, designed so you can customize them to your liking. Its catalog includes 145 components, 15 blocks (hero, pricing, footers) and 2 complete templates, with CLI or manual installation and guides for Tailwind and dark mode.
It's a good fit when you want an interface with eye-catching animations without writing them yourself, and you already work with React and Tailwind.
uses: Building your personal portfolio with the developer portfolio template.
Adding an animated hero or pricing section to a landing page with the ready-made blocks.
Adding components with motion to an existing React app, installing them one by one with the CLI.
caveats: It's designed for React and Tailwind CSS; it doesn't work as-is in other frameworks.
The animated components add JavaScript and motion: check performance on mobile and respect people who prefer less animation.
Its license is MIT with a Commons Clause: you can use it in commercial products, but you can't bundle its components into your own library or kit.
pricingNote: Free, including in commercial projects; the license prohibits reselling or redistributing the components as a library, kit or template.
idealFor: React projects with Tailwind that want ready-made animated components.
